label: Progressive Democrats
description: Liberal on every issue family in the sample: positive on social liberty and equality, immigration inclusion, labor, environment, institutional reform and material support, and justice-leaning rather than punitive on order. Shows the lowest overperformance against the fixed 2018-24 reference.
evidence: AL-DEM-CAUCUS-V1-D9DD26756D5110A94E51: 52 people; social liberty +0.76 (n=49), immigration +0.74 (n=19), labor +0.98 (n=36), order/justice -0.23 (n=47); mean cycle WAR 5.07 (SE 2.23). Owner chose the proposed names on 2026-10-04 after the rebuilt run selected two groups (5-group solution failed the 8% minimum group share).

label: Traditional Democrats
description: The large statehouse core: strongly supportive of material support and moderately of environmental protection and institutional reform, but order-leaning on justice, restrictive on immigration and somewhat conservative on social liberty.
evidence: AL-DEM-CAUCUS-V1-D9DD26756D5110A94E51: 194 people; material support +0.82 (n=190), order/justice +0.67 (n=188), immigration -0.66 (n=56), social liberty -0.27 (n=185); mean cycle WAR 23.75 (SE 1.51). Owner chose the proposed names on 2026-10-04.
